verdict.rationale: Dagster's own docs describe official CLIs. The `create-dagster` CLI is the recommended way to scaffold projects. The `dg` CLI provides commands such as `dg scaffold defs` and `dg dev`, and a probe found a dedicated dg CLI configuration reference. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented CLI features (e.g., machine-readable output or non-interactive modes), independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use in AI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: you can scaffold a new project with the create-dagster CLI (recommended)
You can scaffold Dagster Component definitions in your project from the command line with the `dg scaffold defs` command
